## Context
Split from `upbeat-illadvised-springtail` (155c-218b-c128-4700) per operator decision
2026-08-19: the research must not sit behind the migration's acceptance criteria, so it is
filed here and springtail is blocked by it.

Pydantic AI v2 makes the Responses API the default for `openai:` (the pinned 1.107.2 already
emits a deprecation warning saying so). rebar pins Chat Completions explicitly via the
`openai-chat:` prefix (deprecation repair on `dragonish-sylphic-sheep`) and should migrate
deliberately, after proving compatibility, rather than inherit the semantic change implicitly.

## Scope — evidence only, no migration
This ticket does NOT flip any provider to `openai-responses:`. Its product is (a) the
capability matrix + production-construction constraints, recorded as a comment on this ticket,
and (b) the contract tests that will later prove the migration safe. Edit-set: ONE new file,
`tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py`. No `src/rebar` change — runtime findings are
recorded on this ticket for `155c` to act on, not patched here.

## Approach
Two evidence layers, both against the pinned toolchain (pydantic-ai 1.107.2):

1. **Static + probe inventory** of rebar's OpenAI-compatible surface. The rows are exactly the
   OpenAI-compatible names rebar admits: (i) hosted `openai:` / `openai-chat:`, (ii) the custom
   `base_url` builder `ProviderSession._build_openai` (LMStudio/Ollama/vLLM/LiteLLM recipe,
   story S4), (iii) the per-candidate `endpoint` override (`ProviderSession.model_for`, task
   cc33), (iv) `gateway/openai`, and (v) the OpenAI-compatible vendor qualifiers in
   `KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES` (`deepseek`, `grok`, `xai`, `groq`, `cerebras`, `moonshotai`,
   `heroku`). Each row is classified Responses-ready / Chat-Completions-only / UNKNOWN from
   cited evidence: rebar source (file:line), pinned pydantic-ai behaviour (which model class
   `infer_model` constructs per prefix, verified by probe), and live interpreter probes in
   this worktree. Vendor-side questions the pin already decides are classified from the pin;
   anything requiring off-toolchain evidence is recorded UNKNOWN with the missing evidence
   named.
2. **Contract tests** in `tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py`: a stub
   OpenAI-compatible server behind `httpx.MockTransport` that speaks BOTH wire protocols
   (`/chat/completions` and `/responses`). Injection: the
   `monkeypatch.setattr(httpx, "AsyncHTTPTransport", ...)` seam of
   `test_openai_compatible_provider.py` does NOT reach stock pydantic-ai construction
   (`create_async_http_client()` builds a bare `AsyncClient`; providers.py:277-283), so the
   test builds one explicit production `OpenAIProvider(base_url=<stub url>, api_key="test",
   http_client=httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler)))` and hands it to
   `pydantic_ai.models.infer_model(model_string, provider_factory=lambda name: provider)`,
   the SAME `provider_factory` hook rebar's `ProviderSession.model_for` uses in production,
   so `infer_model` still performs the real prefix→model-class dispatch and genuinely
   constructs `OpenAIChatModel` / `OpenAIResponsesModel`; only the socket inside the
   explicitly-passed client is faked. Tests are parameterized over the two prefixes so the
   identical assertions run against both and the parametrize ids ARE the behavioural diff for
   `155c`. Assertions cover: structured
   output (Agent `output_type` round-trip), streaming (`run_stream` yields text), tool calls
   (a tool-call turn then a final turn), retry behaviour scoped to what the mechanism
   exercises (a 429 from the stub surfaces as `ModelHTTPError` under BOTH prefixes; NOT a
   claim about `ProviderSession._build_openai`'s transport, which cannot build
   `openai-responses:` at all today and is recorded as a matrix constraint, not tested), and
   custom-base-URL routing (requests hit the stub `base_url` at the API-specific path).

Also recorded on the ticket (the production-construction constraints for `155c`): the four
places that today make `openai-responses:` unusable in rebar even though pydantic-ai itself
constructs it — `KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES` (src/rebar/llm/config.py) lacks `openai-responses`;
`_pydantic_ai_known_providers()` (src/rebar/llm/providers.py) derives from
`known_model_names()`, which has no `openai-responses:` entries, so `is_resolvable` is False
and `runner.run()` raises `LLMConfigError`; `_PROFILE_RESOLVERS`
(src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py) has no `openai-responses` key, so capability resolution
degrades; and the `openai:` → `openai-chat:` normalizers (anthropic_model.py `_pai_model`,
model_classes.py `_resolve_target`) hard-code the Chat pin. Default assumption: these are
`155c`'s edit-set, not this ticket's.

## Testing
The deliverable IS tests. Happy path: every parameterized case passes against the stub for both
prefixes where behaviour is common. Failure/edge path: the 429-retry case asserts the error
surface; the structured-output case asserts the parse of a well-formed body. Verified by
`.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py` plus full `make test`,
`make lint`, `make typecheck` in this worktree.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] [non-codebase] A capability-matrix comment on this ticket classifies every row of rebar's
      OpenAI-compatible surface (hosted openai/openai-chat, custom base_url builder,
      per-candidate endpoint override, gateway/openai, deepseek, grok, xai, groq, cerebras,
      moonshotai, heroku) as Responses-ready, Chat-Completions-only, or UNKNOWN, each row with
      a cited source (rebar file:line, pinned pydantic-ai behaviour, or probe transcript) —
      checked by reading the comment.
      provenance: environment=work-b612 worktree venv, pinned pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.2 and openai 2.53.0; principal=RebarBotNava analysis agent; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=simulation — each row established by constructing the real pydantic-ai model in the pinned interpreter through an httpx MockTransport (no live API calls), or by rebar source file:line citation where construction is blocked before transport.
- [x] [non-codebase] The same comment records the production-construction constraints: each rebar code site
      that blocks `openai-responses:` today, with file:line — checked by reading the comment
      against the named sites.
      provenance: environment=work-b612 worktree checkout at origin/main; principal=RebarBotNava analysis agent; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — each blocking site is a file:line citation into this checkout's src/rebar, verified by reading the working-tree source and confirmed by interpreter probes raising the documented errors.
- [x] Contract tests exist at `tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py`, construct REAL
      pydantic-ai models (no mocks of construction; only the transport is stubbed), and assert
      structured-output, streaming, tool-call, retry, and custom-base-URL behaviour — checked
      by reading the test file and running it.
- [x] The tests are parameterized over `openai-chat:` and `openai-responses:` so re-running
      them produces a per-case behavioural diff — checked by the parametrize ids in
      `pytest --collect-only` output.
- [x] [non-codebase] Any endpoint whose status cannot be established from evidence is recorded
      UNKNOWN with the specific missing evidence named — checked by reading the matrix comment.
      provenance: environment=work-b612 worktree venv with pinned deps, no network access to vendor endpoints; principal=RebarBotNava analysis agent; privilege_posture=narrower; instrument=static-analysis — UNKNOWN rows (xai/groq under missing extras, vendor-side Responses support) are exactly where no live call was made and the pinned package set cannot decide, so the matrix names the missing evidence instead of guessing.
- [x] `make test`, `make lint`, `make typecheck` pass in this worktree — checked by running
      them.
